data_immutability.mechanism: The audit Merkle root is sealed in the stasis field. Every heartbeat the sealed tree structure is re-verified (entanglement sync); any alteration to sealed entries raises STASIS_FIELD_BREACH.
guarantees: hash-chained audit trail cannot be rewritten without detection

absolute_privacy.mechanism: Personal identities are encrypted per owner (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 key derivation + SHA-256 counter-mode keystream) and committed into an identity Merkle tree. Plaintext never leaves the field.
absolute_privacy.access_policy: Only the authorized owner's key can open their record; every denied attempt is audited as STASIS_ACCESS_DENIED.

pre_threat_detection.mechanism: Predictive QKD analysis scores every transaction BEFORE acceptance: counterfeit coins (replayed transaction ids, invalid mints) and channel disturbances (self-transfers, low-entropy keys).
pre_threat_detection.outcome: Threats are neutralized pre-acceptance and recorded in the hash-chained audit trail (THREAT_NEUTRALIZED).

algorithms.quantum_entanglement_sync: The field re-seals the live Merkle root each heartbeat and compares the sealed prefix against it — divergence between entangled roots means tampering.
algorithms.predictive_qkd: Replay detection over minted transaction ids plus Shannon-entropy analysis of key material; behavioral disturbance signatures flag compromised channels before an attack initiates.
algorithms.merkle_identity_tree: SHA-256 binary Merkle tree over per-identity commitments; publishes an identity root without exposing any personal data.
algorithms.stasis_encryption: Per-owner PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (10k iterations) key derivation with random salt/nonce and a SHA-256 counter-mode keystream (XOR cipher).

threat_levels.NOMINAL: no threats detected in the last 5 minutes
threat_levels.CRITICAL: 15+ threats in the last 5 minutes (coordinated attack pattern)

api.GET /api/stasis: field status — seal state, Merkle match, privacy coverage, identity tree root, threat level and the neutralized-threat register
